title: The Judgment on Babylon, the Great Prostitute
description: One of the seven angels with the bowls shows John the judgment on the great prostitute who sits upon many waters. John is carried away in the Spirit into a wilderness and sees a woman clothed in purple and scarlet, seated on a scarlet beast with seven heads and ten horns. On her forehead stands the name "Babylon the Great", and she is drunk with the blood of the saints. The angel explains the mystery: the seven heads are seven hills and seven kings, and the ten horns are ten kings who give their power to the beast. They will make war against the Lamb, but the Lamb will conquer as Lord of lords and King of kings. Finally, the ten kings turn against the prostitute and destroy her, until God's word is fulfilled.
